name: The Tram Back
description: One pure-texture check, matching The Road In's own a-flourish exactly -- costs nothing on any result, never mandatory.

dc.basis: level 1 DC 15, one step easy -- a treat, not a test, same convention as c1e1-the-road-in's own a-flourish

outcomes.criticalSuccess: It lands exactly right -- whatever they did or said, somebody else on the tram actually noticed, in a small, real way.
outcomes.success: It goes fine, and it's theirs.
outcomes.failure: Nothing dramatic. The moment just doesn't quite land, which is a completely normal way for a quiet moment to go.
outcomes.criticalFailure: Mildly, harmlessly awkward -- the kind of thing that's funnier in a week than it is right now.

notes: Never mandatory. If nobody reaches for it, the scene loses nothing -- the whole point of this scene is unstructured player-led time, not a checklist.
